definition_zh: 等待；停留；忍耐等待时机；（bide one's time）静候良机；继续存在
definition_en: to stay or wait, especially patiently for the right moment
core_image: 猎手蹲在灌木后一动不动，只等风声过去
scene: 报价被压得太低，他没有争辩，只说再等等。She decided to bide her time until the boss calmed down.
sceneCN: 这里 bide 是「静候时机」（第 1 个义项：耐心等待合适时刻）；句意是她决定等老板气消了再说。

derivatives.zh: a- 加 bide，义为「忍受；遵守；持续存在」，由同源构词扩展而来
abide 的派生名词，义为「遵守；持续」
现在分词转形容词，见于 biding place「藏身等候之所」

senses.title: To wait for the right moment
senses.definition: to wait calmly and patiently until a suitable opportunity comes
senses.definitionCN: 沉着耐心地等待合适的机会到来
senses.example: She decided to bide her time until the boss calmed down.
senses.exampleCN: 她决定等老板气消了再说。
senses.why: The old sense of dwelling stretches naturally into dwelling in time — waiting.
senses.whyCN: 「居留」的古义自然延伸为在时间里居留，即等待。

senses.title: To stay or remain in a place
senses.definition: to stay in a place for a while
senses.example: The wanderer bided a week by the river.
senses.exampleCN: 流浪者在河边停留了一周。
senses.why: The root meaning is simply to dwell or endure in place.
senses.whyCN: 词根本义即在一地居留、耐受。

senses.title: To endure patiently
senses.definition: to bear or put up with something quietly
senses.example: He bided the long winters without complaint.
senses.exampleCN: 他毫无怨言地熬过漫漫寒冬。
senses.why: Waiting and enduring are one posture of stillness.
senses.whyCN: 等待与忍耐是同一种静的姿态。

senses.title: To await an outcome
senses.definition: to wait for something that is coming or developing
senses.definitionCN: 等待某件正在到来或酝酿中的事
senses.example: The scouts bided the enemy's next move.
senses.exampleCN: 侦察兵等着敌人的下一步动作。
senses.why: One can wait not only for chances but for events.
senses.whyCN: 等的不仅是机会，也可以是事件本身。

senses.title: To remain in reserve
senses.definition: to exist quietly, ready for future use or action
senses.definitionCN: 静静存在，以备将来启用或行动
senses.example: An old grudge bided beneath his politeness.
senses.exampleCN: 他的客套之下潜伏着旧怨。
senses.why: What waits without acting is biding in reserve.

senses.title: To continue in existence (archaic)
senses.definition: to last or persist, as of dwellings or customs
senses.definitionCN: 延续、长存，指居所或习俗（旧用法）
senses.example: The old tower has bided through five centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 这座古塔已矗立了五个世纪。
senses.why: Enduring in place across time is dwelling at its longest.
senses.whyCN: 在时间中久居一地，即是最长的居留。

senses.title: To put up with (dialect, with object)
senses.definition: in dialect use, to tolerate or be able to bear
senses.why: Enduring merges into tolerating in northern dialects.
senses.whyCN: 在北方方言中，「熬」与「容忍」合而为一。

senses.title: To dwell (archaic)
senses.definition: to live or dwell somewhere, the earliest sense
senses.definitionCN: 居住于某地，为最早的义项
senses.example: They bided in the valley for generations.
senses.exampleCN: 他们世代居于山谷之中。
senses.why: The verb began as plain dwelling before turning to time.
senses.whyCN: 动词本义是单纯居住，后才转向时间。

intro.en: Bide is an old Germanic verb meaning to dwell and endure.
intro.cn: bide 是古老的日耳曼动词，本义「居住、忍受」。

items.en: the root bheigh- meant to dwell, to be; reconstructed form.
items.cn: 词根 bheigh- 意为「居住、存在」（重构形式）。

items.en: bīdan meant to remain, to await, to endure.
items.cn: 古英语 bīdan 意为「停留、等候、忍受」。

items.en: bīdaną covered dwelling and waiting alike.
items.cn: 原始日耳曼语 bīdaną 兼指居住与等待。

items.en: biden weakened in daily use, keeping mainly the waiting sense.
items.cn: 中古英语 biden 在日常用法中衰弱，主要保留等待义。

items.en: now chiefly in bide one's time, with the plain staying sense literary or dialectal.
items.cn: 如今主要用于 bide one's time，单纯的停留义属文学或方言。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Germanic dwell root; the near-meaning group gathers waiting and enduring words.
note.cn: 形近组共享日耳曼「居留」词根；近义组汇集等待、忍耐类词。

entries.definitionCN: 忍受；遵守；持续——同根加前缀 a-

entries.definition: to offer a price; to command
entries.definitionCN: 出价；吩咐——拼写相近，词源不同
流连；徘徊——强调不愿离去

normalIntro.en: Bide is the old verb behind abide; its core is dwelling and waiting.
normalIntro.cn: bide 是 abide 背后的古动词，核心是居留与等待。

normal.en: The set phrase is bide one's time.
normal.cn: 固定短语是 bide one's time。

normal.en: Abide is bide with a prefix.
It once meant simply to dwell.
Dialect keeps the sense of tolerate.

abstract.en: See the fisherman motionless above the ice hole.
abstract.cn: 看渔夫在冰洞前纹丝不动。

abstract.en: Feel the pause before the spring bud opens.
abstract.cn: 感受春芽绽放前的静默。

abstract.en: Picture an ambush that knows how to be still.

examples.en: She decided to bide her time until the boss calmed down.
examples.cn: 她决定等老板气消了再说。

examples.en: The wanderer bided a week by the river.
examples.cn: 流浪者在河边停留了一周。

examples.en: He bided the long winters without complaint.
examples.cn: 他毫无怨言地熬过漫漫寒冬。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摆的」——先把棋子摆在那里不动，稳稳等着对面出错。

root: 古英语 bīdan「停留、等候、忍受」，上溯至原始日耳曼语 bīdaną 及原始印欧语 bheigh-「居住、存在」（重构形式）；与 abide 同根，现代英语主要存于 bide one's time「静候时机」，单纯停留义属文学与方言。

sensesIntro.en: One old verb of dwelling turns into waiting, enduring, lurking, and lasting.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个古老的「居留」动词长出了等待、忍耐、潜伏与长存。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: stillness that outwaits the moment
core.cn: 核心意象：以静制动、耗得过时刻的静止

intro.en: Bide is a bare Germanic strong verb.
intro.cn: bide 是不带前缀的日耳曼强变化动词。

latinIntro.en: No Latin kin; the bide family is purely Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁同族；bide 词族纯属日耳曼语系。

derivatives.zh: a- 加 bide，义为「忍受；遵守」
现在分词转形容词，义为「等候中的」
